Name: Leyalluna's Wizard Portrait Edit
Author: Saberie
Description:
I love WerewolfMaster's Romancable Rasmodius mod, but I wanted the talk sprites to fit with the rest of the talk portraits that I use, Leyalluna's Portraits. So, I took Leyalluna's two already-made portraits and edited them multiple times to fit over the sprites used in the Romance mod.

This is a simple PNG file, and replaces the VanillaWizard.PNG in the Romancable Rasmodius mod.  Simply take this PNG and drop and replace it into:
[CP] Romancable Rasmodius > assets

Credit for the original portraits are here, I simply edited them.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2181?tab=files&file_id=43123

Downloads.Description: this is the XNB file replacement now, since the content patcher portraits aren't working with the Romancable Rasmodius mod.

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
